# arin_org (Resource)

Manage a complete ARIN organization, including its authoritative POC collection. Creation can require staff review. Pending or uncertain writes retain recovery state and block repeat submission. If creation returns only a ticket, obtain the approved handle from ARIN and import it after reconciling that ticket; see the organization recovery guide. Remove dependent resources before destroy. Do not overlap POC ownership with arin_org_poc. Import existing organizations by handle. Name, address and tax information are sensitive but remain in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Import an existing organization first. Creation may require ARIN staff review.
# This resource owns the complete POC collection, including the Admin contact.
resource "arin_org" "example" {
  name                 = "Example Networks"
  country_code         = "US"
  street_address       = ["123 Example Street"]
  city                 = "Chantilly"
  subdivision          = "VA"
  postal_code          = "20151"
  accept_reassignments = true
  poc_links = [
    { handle = "EXAMPLE-ARIN", function = "AD" },
    { handle = "EXAMPLE-ARIN", function = "T" },
    { handle = "EXAMPLE-ARIN", function = "AB" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_code` (String) Uppercase two-letter country code.
- `name` (String, Sensitive) Immutable legal organization name. Changes require replacement.
- `poc_links` (Attributes Set) Complete POC collection: exactly one AD (Admin), at least one T (Tech), and one AB (Abuse). N, R and D are also supported. Keep a POC linked to the API account to preserve management access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `street_address` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered street address lines.

### Optional

- `accept_reassignments` (Boolean) Accept incoming reassignments and reallocations. Defaults to true.
- `city` (String, Sensitive) City. Omission sends an empty value.
- `comments` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered operational comments. Omission clears comments.
- `dba_name` (String, Sensitive) Immutable doing-business-as name. Changes require replacement.
- `postal_code` (String, Sensitive) Postal code, required for US and CA.
- `rwhois_url` (String, Sensitive) Referral Whois server hostname and port, not a company website URL.
- `subdivision` (String, Sensitive) State or province code, required for US and CA.
- `tax_id` (String, Sensitive) Tax identifier. Omission sends no tax ID element.

### Read-Only

- `country_calling_code` (String) E.164 country calling code returned by ARIN, retained as text.
- `country_code3` (String) Three-letter country code returned by ARIN.
- `country_name` (String) Country name returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) ARIN-generated organization handle. Empty until a pending creation is confirmed.
- `id` (String) Organization handle, or a pending recovery identifier.
- `pending_operation` (String) Empty when complete, otherwise create, update or delete requiring reconciliation.
- `pending_ticket` (String, Sensitive) Unresolved ARIN ticket, or empty for an uncertain outcome without a ticket.
- `registration_date` (String) Generated registration date, preserved during updates.

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Required:

- `function` (String) AD, T, AB, N, R or D.
- `handle` (String) Existing POC handle.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_org.example EXAMPLE-1
```
